title: Ev arkadaşı

characters.GUY1: a young man of about twenty with short brown hair, wearing a mustard yellow hoodie
characters.GUY2: a young man of about twenty with curly red hair and freckles, wearing a green flannel shirt
characters.MAN: a man of about thirty-five with short brown hair, wearing a grey shirt

scenes.text:
Son ekmeği paylaştığın biriyle
şimdi sadece beğeni mi paylaşıyorsun?
scenes.prompt: At night in a tiny student kitchen lit by a single lamp, {GUY1} on the left and {GUY2} on the right sit at a small table laughing, one loaf of bread on the table between them, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Bir zamanlar aynı mutfakta
ay sonunu birlikte getirdiniz.
scenes.prompt: On a winter night in a small student apartment, {GUY1} and {GUY2} sit wrapped in blankets on the floor next to a small heater, laughing, snow falling outside the window.

scenes.text:
Kötü günlerde
sabaha kadar balkonda konuştunuz.
scenes.prompt: At dawn, {GUY1} and {GUY2} sit side by side on a small balcony seen from behind, looking at the sunrise over city rooftops, soft pink sky.

scenes.text:
Şimdi aranızda bir kalp işareti
ve koca bir sessizlik var.
scenes.prompt: In the evening, {MAN} sits alone on a sofa in a tidy apartment, a phone lying on the coffee table in front of him, looking at it thoughtfully, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Bir beğeni değil, bir ses yolla.
Bunu ev arkadaşına gönder.
scenes.prompt: At sunset, {MAN} sits on a park bench laughing warmly, a phone on speaker lying on the bench beside him, golden autumn leaves falling.

caption:
Ev arkadaşın nerede?

Aynı mutfaktan çıkan dostluklar kolay bitmez. 🤍

Bunu ev arkadaşına gönder.
